entries.5513781b6366a05d: This is the segment of business that DENTSU GROUP INC. conducts in Japan, providing communication-related services centered on advertising. The group's business as a whole consists of advertising operations, handling advertising in newspapers, magazines, radio, television, the internet, sales promotion, film, outdoor, transport and others, and planning and producing advertising expression, marketing, PR, content services and others. In addition, the group conducts information services and sales of information-related products as its information services business, and provides specialized corporate-area functions, office leasing, building services and others as other businesses. Revenue from external customers for the group as a whole for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,290,840 million for advertising, ¥144,075 million for information services and ¥329 million for other businesses. The main companies in Japan are Dentsu Inc., which handles the advertising business; the regional companies Dentsu East Japan Inc., Dentsu West Japan Inc. and Dentsu Kyushu Inc.; and Dentsu Digital Inc., which covers the digital area; as well as Dentsu Live Inc., Dentsu Promotion Inc. (renamed from Dentsu Promotion Plus Inc. on January 1, 2026), Dentsu Adgear Inc., Dentsu Runway Inc., Dentsu Meitetsu Communications Inc., CARTA HOLDINGS, Inc., Septeni Holdings Co., Ltd., Dentsu Soken Inc. and Dentsu Corporate One Inc. CARTA HOLDINGS, Inc. was a consolidated subsidiary holding 54.6% of voting rights at the end of December 2025, but effective January 15, 2026, it transferred part of its shares, bringing its equity stake to 48.4%, and it became an equity-method affiliate. Revenue from external customers in Japan for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥605,237 million (105.7% of the prior year), the largest of the four reportable segments.

entries.fee7740f655f3bdd: Based on the medium-term management plan announced in February 2025 (fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027), it positions the recovery of overseas business performance as its top priority and states that it will pursue "review of underperforming businesses and rebuilding of the management foundation," "focus of business strategy" and "financial policy." In its business strategy, it will offer clients "Integrated Growth Solutions", which integrates capabilities in the area where marketing, technology and consulting converge with capabilities in the sports & entertainment area, and will push forward with a focus on Japan and the United States, where it has scale and business assets. In overseas business, it is working to increase added value in its core media area, and since fiscal 2025 it has been seriously pursuing the global expansion of the sports & entertainment business, which it had mainly conducted in Japan until now. Some of the key financial targets and financial policies in the medium-term management plan have been withdrawn for review and are scheduled to be set again.
